title: slaude box definition

name.description: The box's name. Must equal the directory name (boxes/<name>/) and is what an agent.yaml writes under box. Required. Example: ruby-dev

description.description: What the box is for, shown to operators. At most 500 characters. Example: Ruby 3.3 and Node 22 for the storefront repositories

dockerfile.description: The Dockerfile, relative to the box directory. Default Dockerfile.

context.description: The build context, relative to the box directory. Default: the box directory.

build.description: Build the image in CI from a Dockerfile in the box directory. Rebuilt only when a file of the context changes.

ref.description: An image that already exists, by digest. Example: ghcr.io/example/boxes/ruby-dev@sha256:<64 hex characters>

image.description: The box's image: exactly one of build or ref. Required.

tier.description: The weakest sandbox tier this box may run on: gvisor, bwrap or none. Default gvisor. Example: gvisor

cpu.description: Cores the sandbox may use, a ceiling. Default 2. Example: 2

memoryMb.description: Memory ceiling in MB; the sandbox is killed above it. Default 3072. Example: 3072

memoryReserveMb.description: Memory in MB a node sets aside to admit this box. At most memoryMb. Default: a third of memoryMb. Example: 1024

pids.description: Most processes in the sandbox. Default 512. Example: 512

homeMb.description: Size limit of the durable home in MB. Default 4096. Example: 4096

workspaceExtrasMb.description: Size limit in MB of the workspace trees the sync ignore list skips (node_modules, .venv and the like). Default 4096. Example: 4096

rootOverlayMb.description: Size limit in MB of system-level writes, which are thrown away when the sandbox stops. Default 2048. Example: 2048

resources.description: Limits of one sandbox of this box.

allow.description: Hosts the box may reach, port 443 unless stated. Everything else is refused. A leading *. matches every subdomain. Example: [registry.npmjs.org, "*.githubusercontent.com"]

deny.description: Hosts refused even when allow matches them. Example: [uploads.github.com]

egress.description: Where the box may connect. Refuse by default; changed only through the deploy repo.

env.description: Environment variables for the box. Not secret: a value that looks like a credential fails the sync. Example: { BUNDLE_JOBS: "4" }

command.description: The program to run, as an absolute path inside the image. Required. Example: /usr/local/bin/ruby-lsp-mcp

args.description: Arguments for the program. No credential: the server runs inside the box. Example: [--stdio]

stdio.description: Stdio MCP servers that are programs in the image. They get no credential. Example: { ruby-lsp: { command: /usr/local/bin/ruby-lsp-mcp, args: [--stdio] } }

mcp.description: Tool servers that run inside the box.

exclude.description: Home paths that are never kept between sessions' nodes. Example: [.cache/huggingface]

durable.description: What is kept of the home.

force.description: true: sessions on an older image of this box move to this one at their next turn. Default false.

note.description: Shown to users when force is true. At most 500 characters. Example: Ruby moved to 3.4; reinstall gems.

refresh.description: Whether sessions on an older image are moved.

description: A slaude box: one reviewed image plus a policy, at boxes/<name>/box.yaml. Unknown keys are refused at every level, and so is ${ anywhere in the file.
